scanNote:
GRAMMAR REFERENCE, 1-BET (116-bet). Katta qora sarlavha 'Grammar Reference', yashil chiziq.

To'q sariq 'UNIT 1'. 'PRESENT SIMPLE'.

CHAP USTUN:
TO'Q SARIQ JADVAL: Affirmative: I work, you work, he works, she works, it works, we work, you work, they work. Interrogative: Do I work? Do you work? Does he work? Does she work? Does it work? Do we work? Do you work? Do they work? Negative - Long form: I do not work, you do not work, he does not work, she does not work, it does not work, we do not work, you do not work, they do not work. Short form: I don't work, you don't work, he doesn't work, she doesn't work, it doesn't work, we don't work, you don't work, they don't work.
'Form': • We form the present simple with the subject (noun or personal pronoun) and the verb. Affirmative • The third person singular takes -s or -es in the affirmative. Negative • We use subject + don't + main verb in all persons in the negative except the third person singular. We use subject + doesn't + main verb in this person. 'I don't play, he doesn't play.' Interrogative • We use do + subject + verb in all persons except for the third person singular. We use does + subject + verb in this person. 'Do you like football? Does he like tennis?'

O'NG USTUN:
'Spelling: 3rd person singular affirmative': • Most verbs take -s in the third person singular. 'I work - he works' • Verbs ending in -ss, -sh, -ch, -x or -o take -es. 'I go - he goes' • Verbs ending in a consonant + y drop -y and take -ies. 'I fly - he flies' • Verbs ending in a vowel + y take -s. 'I play - he plays'
'Pronunciation': -s or -es in the third person singular is pronounced: • /s/ with verbs ending in /f/, /k/, /p/ or /t/ sounds. 'he sits' • /ɪz/ with verbs ending in /s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/ or /z/ sounds. 'he watches' • /z/ with verbs ending in all other sounds. 'he plays'
'Use': We use the present simple for: • daily routines, repeated actions or habits. 'I get up at seven every day.' • permanent states. 'I live in London.'
OCh SARIQ QUTI: 'Time expressions used with present simple: every hour/day/week/month/summer/year etc, usually, always, every morning/evening/afternoon/night, in the morning/afternoon/evening/night, at night etc.'
'Short Answers' (quti): Do you ...? → Yes, I do./Yes, we do. No, I don't./No, we don't. Does he/she/it ...? → Yes, he/she/it does. No, he/she/it doesn't. Do they ...? → Yes, they do. No, they don't. 'In short answers we use "Yes" or "No" the subject pronoun and do/don't or does/doesn't.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '116'.

exercises.instructionEn: Present Simple - Form. Affirmative: I work, he works. Negative: I do not (don't) work, he does not (doesn't) work. Interrogative: Do I work? Does he work?
exercises.instructionUz: Hozirgi oddiy zamon - Shakli. Tasdiq: I work, he works. Inkor: I do not (don't) work, he does not (doesn't) work. So'roq: Do I work? Does he work?
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE - ShAKLI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  TASDIQ                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  I / you / we / they  WORK
  he / she / it        WORKS

  ⚠ 3-shaxs birlikda -S / -ES.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  INKOR                           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  I / you / we / they  DON'T work
  he / she / it        DOESN'T work

  ⚠ Uzun: do not / does not.
  ⚠ 'doesn't' dan keyin fe'lda -S
  YO'Q: 'he doesn't work' ('works'
  emas!).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SO'ROQ                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  DO I / you / we / they work?
  DOES he / she / it work?

  ⚠ 'Does he like tennis?' - 'likes'
  emas!


⚠ 'A SUBJECT':

  = ega.


⚠ 'THIRD PERSON SINGULAR':

  = 3-shaxs birlik (he, she, it).


⚠ 'THE MAIN VERB':

  = asosiy fe'l.

points.en: We form the present simple with the subject (noun or personal pronoun) and the verb. The third person singular takes -s or -es in the affirmative.
points.uz: Hozirgi oddiy zamonni ega (ot yoki kishilik olmoshi) va fe'l bilan yasaymiz. Tasdiqda 3-shaxs birlik -s yoki -es oladi.

points.en: Negative: We use subject + don't + main verb in all persons except the third person singular. We use subject + doesn't + main verb in this person. I don't play, he doesn't play.
points.uz: Inkor: 3-shaxs birlikdan tashqari barcha shaxslarda ega + don't + asosiy fe'l. 3-shaxs birlikda ega + doesn't + asosiy fe'l. I don't play, he doesn't play.

points.en: Interrogative: We use do + subject + verb in all persons except for the third person singular. We use does + subject + verb in this person. Do you like football? Does he like tennis?
points.uz: So'roq: 3-shaxs birlikdan tashqari barcha shaxslarda do + ega + fe'l. 3-shaxs birlikda does + ega + fe'l. Do you like football? Does he like tennis?

exercises.explanationUz:
3-ShAXS BIRLIK IMLOSI:

  1 Ko'p fe'llar → -S:
    work → works
  2 -ss, -sh, -ch, -x, -o bilan
    tugasa → -ES:
    go → goes, watch → watches,
    kiss → kisses, wash → washes,
    fix → fixes
  3 undosh + y → -y tushib -IES:
    fly → flies, study → studies
  4 unli + y → -S:
    play → plays, buy → buys


⚠ 'A CONSONANT':

  = undosh harf.


⚠ 'A VOWEL':

  = unli harf (a, e, i, o, u).

points.en: Most verbs take -s in the third person singular. I work - he works
points.uz: Ko'p fe'llar 3-shaxs birlikda -s oladi. I work - he works

points.en: Verbs ending in -ss, -sh, -ch, -x or -o take -es. I go - he goes
points.uz: -ss, -sh, -ch, -x yoki -o bilan tugagan fe'llar -es oladi. I go - he goes

points.en: Verbs ending in a consonant + y drop -y and take -ies. I fly - he flies
points.uz: Undosh + y bilan tugagan fe'llar -y ni tashlab -ies oladi. I fly - he flies

points.en: Verbs ending in a vowel + y take -s. I play - he plays
points.uz: Unli + y bilan tugagan fe'llar -s oladi. I play - he plays

exercises.instructionEn: Pronunciation: -s or -es in the third person singular.
exercises.explanationUz:
-S / -ES TALAFFUZI:

  /s/ - jarangsiz undoshdan keyin
    (/f/, /k/, /p/, /t/):
    sits /sɪts/, works /wɜːks/,
    laughs /lɑːfs/, stops /stɒps/

  /ɪz/ - shivirlovchi tovushdan
    keyin (/s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/,
    /z/):
    watches /ˈwɒtʃɪz/, washes,
    kisses, changes, uses

  /z/ - boshqa barcha tovushlardan
    keyin (jarangli undosh, unli):
    plays /pleɪz/, goes /ɡəʊz/,
    runs /rʌnz/, lives /lɪvz/


⚠ Bu qoida OTLARNING KO'PLIGIGA
ham tegishli: cats /s/, dogs /z/,
buses /ɪz/.

points.en: /s/ with verbs ending in /f/, /k/, /p/ or /t/ sounds. he sits
points.uz: /s/ - /f/, /k/, /p/ yoki /t/ tovushlari bilan tugagan fe'llarda. he sits

points.en: /ɪz/ with verbs ending in /s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/ or /z/ sounds. he watches
points.uz: /ɪz/ - /s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/ yoki /z/ tovushlari bilan tugagan fe'llarda. he watches

points.en: /z/ with verbs ending in all other sounds. he plays
points.uz: /z/ - boshqa barcha tovushlar bilan tugagan fe'llarda. he plays

exercises.instructionEn: Use. We use the present simple for daily routines, repeated actions or habits, and permanent states. Time expressions: every hour/day/week/month/summer/year, usually, always, every morning/evening/afternoon/night, in the morning/afternoon/evening/night, at night. Short answers: Yes, I do. / No, I don't. Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
exercises.instructionUz: Ishlatilishi. Hozirgi oddiy zamonni kundalik odatlar, takrorlanuvchi ishlar va doimiy holatlar uchun ishlatamiz. Vaqt iboralari: every hour/day/week/month/summer/year, usually, always, every morning/evening/afternoon/night, in the morning/afternoon/evening/night, at night. Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I do. / No, I don't. Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE - IShLATILIShI:

  1 KUNDALIK ODATLAR, takrorlanuvchi
    ishlar:
    'I GET UP at seven every day.'
  2 DOIMIY HOLATLAR:
    'I LIVE in London.'


VAQT IBORALARI:

  every hour/day/week/month/
    summer/year = har soat/kun/
    hafta/oy/yoz/yil
  usually = odatda
  always = har doim
  every morning/evening = har
    ertalab/kechqurun
  in the morning/afternoon/evening
    = ertalab/tushdan keyin/
    kechqurun
  at night = kechasi

  ⚠ 'IN the morning' lekin 'AT
  night'!


QISQA JAVOBLAR:

  Do you ...? → Yes, I do. / No,
    I don't.
  Does he/she/it ...? → Yes, he
    does. / No, he doesn't.
  Do they ...? → Yes, they do. /
    No, they don't.

  ⚠ Qisqa javobda ASOSIY FE'L
  takrorlanmaydi: 'Yes, I do' ('Yes,
  I like' EMAS).


⚠ 'A ROUTINE':

  = kundalik tartib.


⚠ 'A HABIT':

  = odat.


⚠ 'PERMANENT':

  = doimiy.

points.en: We use the present simple for daily routines, repeated actions or habits. I get up at seven every day.
points.uz: Hozirgi oddiy zamonni kundalik tartib, takrorlanuvchi ishlar yoki odatlar uchun ishlatamiz. Men har kuni yettida turaman.

points.en: We use the present simple for permanent states. I live in London.
points.uz: Hozirgi oddiy zamonni doimiy holatlar uchun ishlatamiz. Men Londonda yashayman.

points.en: Time expressions: every hour/day/week/month/summer/year etc, usually, always, every morning/evening/afternoon/night, in the morning/afternoon/evening/night, at night etc.
points.uz: Vaqt iboralari: har soat/kun/hafta/oy/yoz/yil, odatda, har doim, har ertalab/kechqurun/tushdan keyin/kecha, ertalab/tushdan keyin/kechqurun, kechasi.

points.en: In short answers we use "Yes" or "No", the subject pronoun and do/don't or does/doesn't. Do you ...? - Yes, I do. / No, I don't. Does he ...? - Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
points.uz: Qisqa javoblarda 'Yes' yoki 'No', ega olmoshi va do/don't yoki does/doesn't ishlatamiz.

patterns.exampleEn: I get up at seven every day. She gets up at eight.
patterns.exampleUz: Men har kuni yettida turaman. U sakkizda turadi.

patterns.exampleEn: I don't play tennis. He doesn't play football.
patterns.exampleUz: Men tennis o'ynamayman. U futbol o'ynamaydi.

patterns.exampleEn: Does he like tennis? - Yes, he does.
